title_o: Class-Wide Function-Related Intervention Teams: Effects of Group Contingency Programs in Urban Classrooms

replications.quote: An ABAB reversal design was used to demonstrate intervention effectiveness and experimental control.
Results confirmed that CW-FIT can be used to increase on-task behavior and reduce disruptive behavior of students with or at risk for EBD.

Results revealed the teacher was able to implement CW-FIT with fidelity with corresponding increases in student on-task behavior and teacher praise, though there was little effect on teacher reprimands.
